description: Erection of a part two, part single storey rear extension and rear roof dormer extension and installation of a replacement rear rooflight, two first floor side windows and two replacement ground floor side windows to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  NS/201 (Rev 04); NS/203 (Rev 04); NS/205 (Rev 04); NS/206 (Rev 04); NS/207 (Rev 04); NS/208 (Rev 04); NS/209 (Rev 04)  Received:  27 November 2023;  NS/202 (Rev 02); NS/204 (Rev 02); NS/210 (Rev 01); NS/211 (Rev 02); NS/212  Received:  24 September 2023;  A02  Received:  29 June 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the part two, part single storey rear extension and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
